purpose: Acquire a deep, rights-safe, narration-matched pool of real images and video before assembly or AI support generation.
hard_rule: A search result is a lead, not an asset. Only an exact item page, exact download, item-level rights basis, local file hash, and approved editorial role can enter a production source pool.

providers: Library of Congress Free to Use and Reuse and item-level rights-clear collections
National Archives item-level public-domain or compatible records
Digital Public Library of America Unlimited Re-Use items
Openverse candidates after original-source license verification
source_tiers.automation: API or structured metadata preferred; item-level rights verification required

providers: Detroit Public Library Burton Historical Collection
Wayne State Walter P. Reuther Library and Digital Collections
University of Michigan Bentley Historical Library
source_tiers.automation: discover and preserve identifiers; never promote to production without explicit item reuse terms or written permission
cache API metadata, download the selected file locally, and preserve the exact item URL and creator
manual or browser-assisted exact-item capture; verify the item-specific license and preserve attribution conservatively

providers: Internet Archive and Prelinger item-level compatible records
NASA image and video library when topically relevant
source_tiers.automation: availability never equals permission; exact item metadata decides the role

generic_context_workflow.rule: Generic stock footage is appropriate only for generic actions and consequences. It must match the narration's action and emotional function, have no implied named-city claim, and remain context_only in every manifest and edit.

modern_thumbnail_visual_energy.rule: A modern thumbnail hero or major inset must pass luma, saturation, and contrast checks, or carry an explicit approved monochrome-intent exception. Filters cannot turn a weak source into a pass.
